mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rn , x.qa_id , x.mb_id , x.qa_title , x.qa_content , x.qa_private , x.qa_answer , x.qa_show FROM ( SELECT qa_id, qa_title, qa_content, qa_private, qa_answer, qa_show FROM QNA_TB WHERE qa_writer_id = #{qa_writer_id} AND qa_show = 'Y' ORDER BY qa_id DESC ) x WHERE ROWNUM <= #{end} ) WHERE rn >= #{start}
